name: shadowdroid
description: Run, test and debug Android apps from Codex: through the ShadowDroid CLI on your own emulators and devices, or on a ShadowDroid Cloud emulator with nothing installed locally. Deploy and apply changes, drive the UI, read crashes and logs, inspect network traffic.

interface.shortDescription: Run, test and debug Android apps on emulators and devices
interface.longDescription: Teaches Codex the shadowdroid CLI and opens a live, interactive emulator/device viewer in the Codex in-app browser when you want to see or use the device: build and apply each edit to the device in place, drive and wait on the UI by selector, explain failures from crashes, logs and network traffic, intercept and modify HTTP(S), inject faults, and debug without Android Studio. Locally it needs the shadowdroid CLI on PATH (brew install shadowdroid-dev/tap/shadowdroid, or scoop install shadowdroid on Windows) and adb. Without them, the ShadowDroid Cloud server (mcp.shadowdroid.dev, sign-in with your ShadowDroid account; invite-only alpha) keeps the project in a cloud workspace, builds it there and runs it on a cloud emulator.
